create_GPT2_tokenizer: create a GPT2 tokenizer instance with an optional cache directory for pretrained weights
tokenize_document: tokenize a text document into GPT2 tokens and append an end-of-document token
encode_text_with_eod: encode a string of text using the GPT2 tokenizer and append the EOD token
review_Tokenizer_class: review the Tokenizer class that wraps GPT2Tokenizer for model parallel training workflows
check_vocab_size: check that the GPT2 vocabulary size fits within a uint16 constraint
